procedures.defeat: One name, zero incense, genuine G25 erasure and extinguish window.
procedures.storage: Disposable mirror checks actual night, codex and replay paths before input.

scope: Native UI input and short declared simulation fixtures; not ordinary example-night balance.
initial_attempts: Earlier title-enabled snapshot caught a pending CombatHUD type-inference error. The final snapshot includes its fix.

Original system font missed some simplified Chinese glyphs at small sizes. The retained frames use the imported project glyph coverage resource.
